architecture:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a 16:9 white technical architecture diagram titled "Chyron × Twitch". User specifically needs Twitch integration emphasized, not a generic AI cloud diagram. Restrained Apple-like sans-serif, large readable short labels, purple Twitch boxes, slate Chyron boxes, white background, generous margins, no logos required, no emoji, no decoration, no marketing, no paragraph text. Three clean HORIZONTAL rows, aligned on a grid, all flowing LEFT TO RIGHT. 
TOP ROW heading "Identity": "Twitch OAuth" -> "Chyron account session". Below OAuth short label "Chat scopes + optional stream-key access". Below session "Broadcaster ID · encrypted tokens". This row is quiet and compact.
MIDDLE ROW heading "Live conversation": "Twitch channel chat" -> "Twitch EventSub" -> "Chyron coverage" -> "Live overlay". Below EventSub "Messages · deletes · user / channel clears". Below coverage "Structured stories · evidence IDs". Below Live overlay "Headlines · quotes · ticker". These four boxes are the largest, most prominent row. Under coverage a small "AWS Bedrock" box connected upward, with short label "GLM coverage · Gemma transcription"; on its left a small "Mic / tab audio" box connects right into Bedrock. Under Live overlay a small quiet "AppSync Events" box connects upward with label "Revision updates". A small "DynamoDB" label with a line into coverage means account state storage; supporting infrastructure must be visually secondary.
BOTTOM ROW heading "Video to Twitch": "Composed preview" -> "OBS or browser relay" -> "Twitch ingest" -> "Twitch viewers". Under OBS or browser relay "Browser path: WebM → FFmpeg". Under Twitch ingest "RTMPS". Connect Live overlay down to Twitch viewers using a single clean outer connector? NO: Do not connect directly to Twitch viewers; overlay supplies composed preview. Instead use only a separate clear line from Live overlay down routed along far right margin then left into Composed preview, label "Overlay layer", without crossing any boxes. If such line is difficult omit it; the row labels explain relationship. NO direct arrow from Bedrock to Twitch ingest. No service inventory. Main understanding: Twitch signs the streamer in, delivers live chat and moderation, receives broadcast video, and shows overlays to viewers. Max 14 boxes. Label typography must be large and fit.
codex: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset: GitHub README development workflow image. Create a clean 16:9 landscape diagram titled "Building Chyron with Codex". White background, generous margins, calm Apple-like sans-serif, short readable labels, restrained purple and slate fills, consistent thin orthogonal arrows. No emojis, decoration, hype, paragraphs or fake screenshots. Show left-to-right main path with five evenly spaced boxes: "User direction" -> "Repository context" -> "Codex" -> "Implementation" -> "Verification". Under user direction one line "Twitch workflow · visual references". Under repository one line "Source · guides · prior chats". Make Codex central, slightly emphasized in soft violet, one-line label "Inspect · edit · run tools". Under Implementation one line "Chat · overlays · audio · broadcast". Under Verification one line "Tests · model calls · browser checks". Below center, three smaller tool boxes directly connected from Codex: "Shell + Git", "Browser / computer use", "Connected tools". Under right side a box "Review + deploy" reached from Verification; small line "GitHub main · Vercel · AWS". Draw ONE clear return arrow from Verification down and back to User direction, labelled "Observed behavior + corrections", separate from tool connectors. Add a quiet short bottom caption "Development workflow". Make it clear this describes Codex helping develop Chyron, not Codex processing live Twitch chat. Do not depict hidden OpenAI internals or claim autonomous perfection. Minimal balanced composition with no crossing lines.
